note: One record per consulted public occurrence. URL records preserve source lineage and claim boundaries; source bytes are not local snapshots. Public occurrences corroborate literal names and family context but do not replace the family-held tree or a civil/family register.

artifacts.title: Adachi Mineichiro Papers inventory
artifacts.publisher: National Diet Library, Constitutional Materials Room
artifacts.page_or_record: PDF p.125; letters 601, 601-1, and 601-2; Reel 27 frames 271 and 274
artifacts.information: The archive inventory jointly names 松井慶四郎・照子 on correspondence records dated 1930-01-01 and 1934-10-26.
artifacts.evidence_assessment: Direct independent corroboration of the exact paired names in an archival catalog; the uninspected letters, not the catalog, would be needed to characterize their relationship from this source alone.

artifacts.title: Introduction to Chiyo Tanaka
artifacts.publisher: Tokyo Tanaka Junior College Alumni Association
artifacts.information: States that Chiyo Tanaka was born as the eldest daughter among the four children of Baron 松井慶四郎 and 照子.
artifacts.evidence_assessment: Institutional corroboration that Keishiro and Teruko were a parental couple; it does not identify Teruko's parents.

artifacts.title: Founder Chiyo Tanaka
artifacts.information: States that Chiyo Tanaka was born the eldest daughter of later foreign minister Baron 松井慶四郎 and 照子.
artifacts.evidence_assessment: A second institutional occurrence in the same educational lineage; corroborates the parental-couple context but is not counted as an independent lineage from the alumni page.

artifacts.title: 今村清之助君事歴
artifacts.page_or_record: NDL bibliographic ID 000000435670; PID 781060; 594 pages; published September 1906
artifacts.information: The NDL catalogs a 1906 biography of 今村清之助 (1848-1902), whose first section is 家系 / family line.
artifacts.evidence_assessment: Direct for Seinosuke Imamura's historical identity and existence of a near-contemporary genealogical source; the restricted body was not inspected for Teruko.

artifacts.title: Matsui Keishiro baronial family
artifacts.page_or_record: family summary lines naming wife 今村照子
artifacts.information: Identifies Keishiro's wife as 今村照子, born 1879, and calls her a daughter of railway magnate 今村清之助; separately identifies Akira as their eldest son.
artifacts.evidence_assessment: Independent modern secondary corroboration of the family-tree interpretation, not primary proof. It shares one lineage with the Easthall Hara claim already tracked elsewhere.
